Who We Are

Twenty-seven years of sourcing the right part, the first time.

Exporter Manufacturer Trader Supplier Importer

Founded in 1999 out of Surat, Gujarat, R.K. Instruments & Controls works at the point where combustion engineering meets procurement: we manufacture, import and distribute the burner, boiler and gas-handling components that oil, gas, chemical, pharmaceutical and thermal plants rely on every day.

Our catalog spans ignition electrodes to full valve-proving systems, drawn from established global manufacturers, so an engineer can specify a part once and trust it will still be in stock — and still be correct — years later.

QA

Quality Assurance

Every component is checked against manufacturer spec before it leaves our floor — no substitutions without sign-off.

Solenoid Valves Brahma DN15 · 1/2"

Brahma Solenoid Valve EG12*L*GMO — DN15 (1/2") Gas Shut-Off Valve

Product Code 13922051 · Solenoid Type BE6*GMO · Code 18811108

The Brahma EG12*L*GMO is a Class A automatic gas solenoid valve built for burner, boiler and gas-train shut-off duty on 1/2" (DN15) BSP connections. Rated to 250 mbar max inlet pressure and IP54 enclosure protection, it runs on a 230V, 50-60Hz, 20VA coil for fast, reliable open/close switching on commercial and industrial combustion systems. R.K. Instruments & Controls stocks genuine Brahma EG-series solenoid valves in Surat for burner OEMs, boiler retrofits and gas-train spares across India.
